economic_thesis: Perpetual funding is an observable transfer price for directional inventory. A persistent cross-sectional funding extreme marks a crowded side, but crowding alone can persist. Requiring relative price to move against that crowded side identifies an unwind while preserving relative carry: short high-funding relative laggards and long low-funding relative leaders.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The short sleeve targets relatively high-funding assets whose prices have become relative laggards; the balanced long sleeve limits market beta.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The long sleeve targets relatively low-funding assets whose prices have become relative leaders; crowded weak names remain available to the short sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Balanced sleeves seek cross-sectional funding transfer and crowd unwind rather than market direction; failure to produce positive chop return falsifies the mechanism.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long low-relative-funding contracts only after positive relative-price confirmation.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short high-relative-funding contracts only after negative relative-price confirmation.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Breadth requirements can force flat exposure, while organizer-owned brakes and volatility targeting are evaluated prospectively as separate policies; stress must still satisfy every frozen gate.

falsifier: Reject or pivot if causal stitched OOF evidence fails any development or team-declared A5 score gate in qualification_thresholds.json, if either sleeve is immaterial, if bull/bear/chop net return is nonpositive, if funding-only or price-only ablations match the joint rule, or if the result is an isolated parameter peak. DNF rather than submit a negative or unqualified IS model.
mechanism: At 00:00 UTC, estimate seven-day exponentially decayed funding pressure from strictly past events, cross-sectionally rank it, and combine the opposite-crowding margin with contiguous past-close relative confirmation into one signed score. Pass that exact final dictionary through the A5 identity boundary before filtering. Select both sleeves independently from the returned scores, rank and proportionally allocate by returned magnitude subject to the symbol cap, require breadth on both, and equalize gross exposure without an estimated hedge ratio.
risk_policy_plan: Run the center first with root no-control risk_policy.json and apply every numeric comparison in qualification_thresholds.json#/core_alpha_activation. Volatility-target-only, drawdown-only, position-stop-only, turnover-only, and combined policies remain dormant unless that core passes. Controls cannot rescue failure. Before any later policy commit, registration, and run, copy its immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json because the frozen lifecycle reads only that path.
selection_metric: Binary eligibility first: every frozen development, A5 score, regime, sleeve, stability, concentration, and doubled-cost gate must pass on stitched chronological evidence. Among passers only, maximize the lower of net Sharpe and doubled-cost Sharpe, then the worst fold/regime Sharpe. A non-passer cannot be selected.

economic_thesis: Funding-crowd unwinds can work outside broad declines, but in market-wide selloffs low funding often marks distress rather than opportunity. A causal router therefore retains confirmed carry unwind in normal conditions and, during broad declines, instead buys relative resilience and shorts downside fragility measured by relative trend, downside capture, and drawdown depth.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The fragility route longs shallow-drawdown, low-downside-capture relative leaders and shorts deep-drawdown, high-downside-capture laggards.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The normal route preserves the confirmed funding-crowding unwind that supported the parent family's bull behavior.
expected_regime_roles.chop: The normal route preserves balanced relative carry/unwind selection rather than imposing directional market exposure.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Normal route: confirmed low-funding relative leaders. Bear route: relative resilience with low downside capture and shallow drawdown.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Normal route: confirmed high-funding relative laggards. Bear route: high downside capture, deep drawdown, and negative relative trend.
expected_regime_roles.stress: The bear route changes security selection without reducing gross or invoking an optional risk policy; all central drawdown and tail gates remain binding.

falsifier: Reject pivot-01 if its no-control core fails any qualification_thresholds.json core_alpha_activation, pivot_01_mechanism_gate, full non-neighborhood development, or team-declared A5 score requirement, including nonpositive bear return or Sharpe, maximum drawdown above 0.30, lost bull/chop behavior, an inactive sleeve, or isolated stability. Controls and neighbors cannot rescue failure.
mechanism: At each 00:00 UTC decision, derive a causal seven-day cross-sectional market return and negative breadth. Outside a broad decline, score the parent confirmed funding-crowd unwind. When median market return is at most -4% and negative breadth is at least 65%, rank each symbol by 45% relative trend, 35% inverse downside beta, and 20% inverse drawdown depth, then rerank the composite. Convert the active route to one signed long-desirability dictionary, cross the A5 boundary once, and use the returned scores for selection and allocation.
risk_policy_plan: Run pivot-01 first with byte-exact root no-control risk_policy.json. Optional controls and neighbors are dormant unless the new core passes qualification_thresholds.json core_alpha_activation, pivot_01_mechanism_gate, every full non-neighborhood development gate, and every team-declared A5 score gate; they cannot repair the terminal parent family or rescue a failed pivot.
selection_metric: All noncompensatory development and A5 gates first. Among passers only, prioritize positive bear Sharpe, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, retained positive bull/chop returns, then the lower of base and doubled-cost Sharpe and worst fold/regime Sharpe.

economic_thesis: Crypto assets exhibit persistent relative leadership and weakness over multi-month horizons, but the most crash-fragile contracts can destroy both long and short books before that spread realizes. A slow pure-crypto residual-persistence strategy should retain cross-sectional return information across bull, bear, and chop while excluding the most fragile fifth of both sleeves and shrinking every remaining position by the same captured safety-adjusted score.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Long persistent relative leaders and short persistent relative laggards only within the crash-screened native-crypto set; low gross and broad sleeves limit damage from discontinuous moves.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Long durable relative leaders and short durable laggards without requiring a directional market forecast.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Three-block agreement rejects one-block noise while the broad neutral spread seeks persistent coin-level dispersion.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Up to eight crash-screened persistent relative leaders, with each position reduced by its captured conviction-and-safety magnitude.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Up to eight crash-screened persistent relative laggards; extreme jump/drawdown names are excluded rather than used as tempting high-beta shorts.
expected_regime_roles.stress: At the center, requested side gross cannot exceed 0.10 and symbol weight cannot exceed 0.015; pairing only scales down, and no portfolio-state overlay restores exposure.

falsifier: Reject pivot-02 if the no-control core is insolvent, fails any qualification_thresholds.json core_alpha_activation, pivot_02_mechanism_gate, full non-neighborhood development, or A5 requirement, loses positive bull/bear/chop behavior, has an inactive sleeve, or later fails its preregistered neighborhood stability gate. No control, neighbor, or further mechanism pivot can rescue failure.
mechanism: Every 72 hours from the Unix epoch anchor, use 270 contiguous completed eight-hour returns. Remove each bar's pure-crypto cross-sectional median, rank cumulative residual return in three nonoverlapping 90-bar blocks, and reward sign agreement. Independently rank recent downside semideviation, largest absolute return, and drawdown depth at 40%/35%/25%; encode the most fragile 20% as zero and shrink all other signed persistence scores by fragility percentile. Cross the A5 boundary once, select broad positive and negative tails, map captured magnitude directly to weights, and only scale the larger sleeve downward to equalize gross.
risk_policy_plan: Run pivot-02 first with byte-exact root no-control risk_policy.json. Neighbors remain dormant until the center passes every core, pivot-02, A5, and non-neighborhood full-development gate. Controls remain dormant until that center and the complete preregistered neighborhood pass every full-development gate; they cannot repair either prior family or rescue a failed final pivot.
selection_metric: Binary noncompensatory eligibility first: completed without insolvency, every core/full-development/A5/pivot-02 gate, then neighborhood stability. Among passers only, maximize the lower of base and doubled-cost Sharpe, then worst regime/fold Sharpe, then minimize drawdown and gross exposure. A non-passer cannot be selected.
